bootstrap.construction: Circular blocks reduced independently to origin frequencies; method/learner pairing preserved.

interpretation.aggregation: Within each fixed cell, average each origin's six learner scores; this is not the CRPS of an ensemble CDF. Then average cell-level ratios equally.
interpretation.interval: Resampling occurs only within the 22 fixed cells. It does not sample markets or capture cross-cell dependence, and does not establish transferable gains across markets or future shifts.
interpretation.epoch_zero: 46 selected initialization checkpoints are validation fallback after 60 logged training epochs per job; they are not zero-training jobs. All 132 histories contain 61 epoch records and satisfy 60*ceil(n_train/64) optimizer-step accounting.
interpretation.control_selection_counts: 63 fits select a nonzero lambda in at least one gate coordinate, which does not imply an active update. Only 14 main gates are nonzero, and only 6 issued gate paths differ from same-joint raw, all in one cell.
interpretation.fit_evidence: Training work is reconciled from the archived full histories, job receipts, source and checkpoint hashes; the audit does not claim to have re-executed or independently observed every historical gradient step.
interpretation.limits: Only the supplied prepared development dataset is opened. Matching scaler state and standardized training moments do not independently re-authenticate source prices. Normal-mixture coverage and width are aggregated as archived; normalized CRPS, price CRPS and price mean MSE are recomputed for every method and origin.

post_start_source_change_proof.kind: Date-only guard before price conversion, declared after the 22 prepared panels were complete.
post_start_source_change_proof.computational_effect_on_prepared_2023_or: None; existing arrays and all checkpoint/score hashes independently verified below.

audit_development_record.first_invocation: Stopped at the runner hash mismatch before checkpoint replay.
audit_development_record.second_invocation: Completed all numerical checks, retained numerical_pass_pending_runner_identity rather than silently passing the changed file.
audit_development_record.final_resolution: Read the declared post-start date guard fix and independently reverse only that exact block; SHA256 matches the original frozen bytes. Final replay repeats verification only, never a fit.
